policies.name: small-transfers-are-permitted
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"transfer", resource) when { context.amount <= 1000 };

policies.name: large-transfers-are-forbidden
policies.code: forbid(principal, action == Action::"transfer", resource) when { context.amount > 1000 };
